maddeler.e:
احتضرنا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَضَرْنَا (iḥtaḍarnā) /iħ.ta.dˤar.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# اُحْتُضِرْنَا (uḥtuḍirnā) /uħ.tu.dˤir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
